extracted.name: Cherry Tomato Salad
extracted.description: Recipe video above. This fresh, juicy tomato salad brings together two of the greatest flavour combinations known to mankind - tomato and basil! Make this with cherry tomatoes or grape tomatoes, or even normal tomatoes cut into chunks.The vinaigrette is slightly thickened with mustard so it clings to the tomato better, and a touch of red onion provides some much needed freshness.
ingredient_lines: 750g/ 1.5lb cherry tomatoes or grape tomatoes ((or large tomatoes))
1/2 cup basil leaves (, tightly packed, finely sliced (Note 2))
1/2 tsp dijon mustard ((or other non spicy mustard))
instruction_lines: Shake Dressing in a jar. Taste and add more salt or pepper, or oil if you want less tart.
Cut Tomatoes - cut cherry tomatoes / grape tomatoes in half. If using large ones, cut into wedges then bite size pieces.
Place tomatoes, onion and basil in a bowl.
Pour over Dressing. Gently toss and serve immediately.
